Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AON.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 512 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 172 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
Operating income reached $6.0 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.43 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
